title: The Hidden Logic of Academic Word Pairs
text:
Academic writing depends heavily on collocations, the fixed pairings of words that native writers use almost without thinking. A researcher might conduct an experiment, but would rarely carry out a test in the same way. Such combinations are difficult to learn because they cannot always be predicted from the meanings of their parts. Students who ignore them often produce sentences that are grammatically correct yet sound unnatural to an experienced reader.

The most reliable way to acquire these patterns is extensive reading of academic journals, where phrases such as draw a conclusion or make an assumption recur constantly. Learners should record collocations in context rather than as isolated lists. Over time, repeated exposure allows the expressions to become automatic. Mastering them is therefore less about memorising rules than about developing a sensitivity to what sounds appropriate.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, why are collocations difficult to learn?
options: They are always written in capital letters
They cannot always be predicted from the meanings of their parts
They are used only by children

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what should learners record?
options: Collocations in context rather than as isolated lists

questions.text: What can be inferred about students who ignore collocations?
options: Their sentences will be completely unacceptable to readers
Their work may seem correct but unnatural to experienced readers
They will never learn to write academically

questions.text: What does the writer suggest about mastering collocations?
options: It depends mainly on memorising rules
It requires developing a sense of what sounds appropriate
It can be achieved in one week
It is unnecessary for advanced learners

vocabulary.definition: fixed combinations of words that commonly occur together
guessed in advance from known information
covering a large amount or area
an awareness of subtle differences in meaning or style

paragraph_translations: Akademik yazım, neredeyse düşünmeden kullanılan sabit kelime eşleşmeleri olan kolokasyonlara büyük ölçüde dayanır. Bir araştırmacı deney yürütebilir, ancak aynı şekilde test yapmaktan nadiren söz eder. Bu tür birleşimleri öğrenmek zordur, çünkü bunlar her zaman bileşenlerinin anlamlarından tahmin edilemez. Bunları göz ardı eden öğrenciler, dilbilgisi açısından doğru ama deneyimli bir okura doğal gelmeyen cümleler yazar.

Bu kalıpları edinmenin en güvenilir yolu, draw a conclusion ve make an assumption gibi ifadelerin sürekli tekrarlandığı akademik dergileri geniş ölçüde okumaktır. Öğrenciler kolokasyonları tek başına listeler halinde değil, bağlam içinde kaydetmelidir. Zamanla tekrarlanan karşılaşmalar bu ifadelerin otomatik hale gelmesini sağlar. Bu nedenle onlara hakim olmak, kuralları ezberlemekten çok neyin uygun duyulduğuna dair bir duyarlılık geliştirmekle ilgilidir.
